Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Mizoram PSC to complete the application.

Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Mizoram PSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mizoram PSC Peon recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Mizoram PSC Peon recruitment is 13th October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Peon post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is a Class-VIII certificate or above from a recognized institution. Proficiency in Mizo language is also a requirement, with some exemptions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Peon position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Peon post is between 18 years and 35 years as of 1st August 2026. Age relaxation is provided for ST/SC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Peon post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Peon (PE) post by the Mizoram Public Service Commission in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Mizoram PSC Peon recruitment must be submitted online through the official Mizoram PSC online portal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Peon post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Peon post will be placed at Level – 1 in the Pay Matrix, as per the government norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for ST/SC candidates, who can avail of up to 5 years of relaxation in the upper age limit.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Peon recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Peon recruitment will be based on a Direct Recruitment Examination conducted by the Mizoram Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Mizoram PSC?
faq.answer: The official website of the Mizoram Public Service Commission is https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in, where you can find more details and apply online.
